options.signature_dish: Homura Spicy Minced Pork Abura Soba with Onsen Tamago
options.description: Nagoya's famous soupless dry ramen specialist tossing springy thick noodles in aromatic chili oil, vinegar, and savory minced pork.
options.address: 214 Queen St W, Toronto, ON M5V 1Z2
options.hours_note: Sun-Thu 11:30 AM - 10:30 PM, Fri-Sat 11:30 AM - 11:30 PM
options.bullet_flavor: Swirl chili oil & vinegar to emulsify the runny egg; free extra noodles or rice
options.bullet_highlight: Nagoya dry abura soba icon with springy noodles clinging to rich umami tare

review_notes.summary: 名古屋油拉面元祖歌志轩（Kajiken）DT分店！无汤干拌油面界的顶流，面条筋道Q弹挂汁无敌。
review_notes.must_try:
🍜 招牌焰油拉面 (Homura Abura Soba with spicy minced pork & onsen egg)
🥩 慢烤牛肉油拉面 (Roast Beef Abura Soba) & 炙烤叉烧油拉面
review_notes.tips: 上桌趁热根据教程沿碗淋 2 圈辣油与白醋，快速搅拌让半熟温泉蛋与浓郁酱汁完全乳化包裹每根面条；支持免费加面或加米饭拌剩余肉酱。
review_notes.vibe: 明亮温馨的日系拉面专门店，适合一人食快餐或好友结伴嗦面

highlights: Nagoya dry abura soba icon with springy noodles clinging to rich umami tare
Swirl chili oil & vinegar to emulsify the runny egg; free extra noodles or rice
options.description_zh: 名古屋油拉面元祖歌志轩DT店！无汤干拌油面界的顶流，面条筋道Q弹挂汁无敌，淋辣油与白醋快速乳化。
highlights_zh: 名古屋油拉面元祖品牌，面条筋道Q弹牢牢吸附秘制浓郁酱汁
趁热淋2圈辣油与白醋乳化半熟温泉蛋，免费续面或米饭拌肉酱
options.signature_dish_zh: 招牌焰油拉面佐温泉蛋与秘制肉酱

review_notes_en.summary: The downtown Toronto outpost of Kajiken, the original pioneer of Nagoya-style dry abura soba noodles.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍜 Signature Homura Abura Soba (Spicy minced pork, fragrant fish powder, nori, scallions, and runny onsen egg)
🥩 Slow-Roasted Wagyu Beef Abura Soba with butter onion sauce & Torch-seared Chashu
review_notes_en.tips: Follow the house ritual upon serving: swirl 2 rounds of chili oil and rice vinegar around the piping-hot bowl, then toss vigorously so the runny onsen egg emulsifies into a creamy sauce coating every springy noodle strand. Free noodle or rice refills to mix with remaining pork sauce!
review_notes_en.vibe: Bright, cheerful modern Japanese ramen bar ideal for quick solo dining or casual noodle slurping with friends

options.name: Zakkushi on Queen
options.signature_dish: Binchotan Charcoal Yakitori & Kurobuta Don
options.description: Classic Queen West Japanese izakaya renowned for fragrant binchotan charcoal-grilled yakitori skewers and comforting savory rice bowls.
options.address: 620 Queen St W, Toronto, ON M6J 1E4
options.hours_note: Mon-Fri 5:30 PM - 12:00 AM, Sat-Sun 12:00 PM - 12:00 AM
options.bullet_flavor: Smoky binchotan charcoal aroma on succulent chicken skewers and tender chashu don
options.bullet_highlight: Longstanding Queen West izakaya institution with authentic tavern energy and approachable pricing

review_notes.summary: Queen街超级老牌的日式炭火居酒屋，多年来价格亲民稳定，水族馆或逛街后绝佳聚餐据点。
review_notes.must_try:
🍢 备长炭烤串组合 (鸡肉丸子、烤鸡翅、牛舌、紫苏五花肉)
🍚 温泉蛋黑豚丼 / 烧肉丼 & 明太子乌冬
review_notes.tips: 串烧现点现烤镬气十足，外焦里嫩炭香浓郁；人均40刀左右性价比极高，建议提前定位或开门时前往。
review_notes.vibe: 烟火气十足的传统日式木质居酒屋，氛围热闹治愈

highlights: Classic Queen West charcoal-grilled yakitori tavern with authentic tavern bustle and steady pricing
Fragrant binchotan skewers alongside rich onsen egg chashu rice bowls for satisfying evening comfort
options.name_zh: ざっ串 炭火居酒屋 (Queen West)
options.description_zh: Queen街超级老牌正宗日式炭火居酒屋，以备长炭香气四溢的烧鸟串烧与浓郁温泉蛋烧肉丼饭闻名，性价比极佳。
highlights_zh: Queen街多年老牌日料居酒屋，人均40刀价格亲民且水准稳定
现烤备长炭烧鸟串焦香四溢，搭配温泉蛋黑豚丼治愈感满满
options.signature_dish_zh: 备长炭烤鸡肉串烧组合与温泉蛋黑豚丼

review_notes_en.summary: A beloved long-standing Queen West yakitori tavern celebrated for fragrant binchotan skewers, comforting donburi, and steady value.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍢 Charcoal Yakitori Platter (Tsukune chicken meatballs, chicken wings, beef tongue, shiso pork belly)
🍚 Kurobuta Pork Don with onsen egg & Mentai Carbonara Udon
review_notes_en.tips: Skewers are grilled to order over real binchotan charcoal for irresistible smoky char. At around $40/person, it's one of downtown's best izakaya values. Reserve ahead for weekend evenings.
review_notes_en.vibe: Warm, bustling Japanese tavern filled with smoky charcoal aromas and cheerful izakaya chatter

options.name: Grandma Kitchen
options.signature_dish: Authentic Sichuan Spicy Chicken Pot & Dry Pot Cauliflower
options.description: Beloved Spadina Chinatown Sichuan kitchen serving hearty, authentic homestyle spicy chicken pots and generous stir-fries near UTSG.
options.address: 416 Spadina Ave, Toronto, ON M5T 2G7
options.bullet_flavor: Fiery chili oil and bold Sichuan peppercorn heat with ultra-generous homestyle portions
options.bullet_highlight: UTSG student favorite along Spadina for authentic, heavily portioned Sichuan comfort

review_notes.summary: 唐人街靠近多大UTSG的正宗川菜小馆，分量极大、麻辣过瘾，是留学生课后聚餐与打包首选。
review_notes.must_try:
🥘 川味香辣柴火鸡煲 / 辣子鸡
🥦 干锅花菜 & 风味茄子 (下饭神器)
review_notes.tips: 菜量非常大且下饭，辣味地道浓烈，建议多叫几碗白米饭；稍微偏油润，重度嗜辣星人狂喜。
review_notes.vibe: 烟火气十足的亲切川味家常小馆，经济实惠分量足

highlights: UTSG student staple on Spadina serving intensely authentic, highly portioned Sichuan comfort
Sizzling spicy chicken pot and wok-tossed dry pot cauliflower delivering fiery chili-oil satisfaction
options.name_zh: 阿婆私房菜 (外婆私房菜)
options.description_zh: 唐人街靠近UTSG的正宗川菜私房馆，以超大分量的地道香辣鸡煲、干锅花菜与浓郁家常镬气闻名。
highlights_zh: UTSG留学生私藏DT川菜馆，菜量极其豪爽、性价比突出
正宗川式香辣鸡煲与干锅系列镬气十足，嗜辣星人下饭必吃
options.signature_dish_zh: 正宗川味香辣鸡煲与干锅花菜

review_notes_en.summary: A go-to Chinatown homestyle Sichuan eatery near UTSG campus, famous for enormous portions and fiery, authentic wok heat.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🥘 Authentic Sichuan Spicy Chicken Pot / Chongqing Chili Chicken
🥦 Griddle Dry-Pot Cauliflower & Crispy Sweet-Savory Eggplant
review_notes_en.tips: Portions are impressively large with genuine Sichuan oil and numbing spice. Order extra steamed rice to mop up the rich sauces.
review_notes_en.vibe: Lively, casual neighborhood dining hall packed with students and spicy food enthusiasts

options.name: Sang's Great Seafood Restaurant
options.signature_dish: Nourishing Herbal Chicken Hot Pot & Fresh Hand-Cut Beef
options.description: Iconic Chinatown late-night destination celebrated for rich herbal chicken hot pots, fresh hand-cut beef, and soothing winter comfort.
options.address: 343 Spadina Ave, Toronto, ON M5T 2G3
options.hours_note: Sun-Thu 4:00 PM - 2:00 AM, Fri-Sat 4:00 PM - 4:00 AM
options.bullet_flavor: Deep comforting herbal broth simmered with tender bone-in chicken and premium sliced meats
options.bullet_highlight: Toronto's legendary late-night chicken hot pot landmark, open until 4 AM for snowy night gatherings

review_notes.summary: 多伦多唐人街老字号深夜鸡锅天花板！冬天下雪或肝due夜聚首选，一碗热气腾腾的走地鸡汤暖心暖胃。
review_notes.must_try:
🍲 招牌药膳走地鸡煲 / 胡椒猪肚鸡锅
🥩 手切新鲜牛小排、响铃卷与鲜打虾滑
review_notes.tips: 开锅先连喝两碗鲜美浓郁的鸡汤，鸡肉肉质紧实滑嫩毫不干柴；营业至凌晨2点到4点，宵夜神店。
review_notes.vibe: 热气氤氲、充满人情味的经典粤式宵夜打边炉氛围

highlights: Legendary Toronto late-night chicken pot institution open until 4 AM for winter night warmth
Simmered herbal bone-in chicken broth paired with tender chicken pieces and fresh hand-cut beef
options.description_zh: 多伦多唐人街老字号深夜暖胃鸡煲名店，以浓郁药膳走地鸡煲、鲜嫩鸡肉与深夜营业至凌晨闻名。
highlights_zh: 多伦多最火老字号鸡煲打边炉，冬天下雪天与朋友聚餐的暖胃顶流
药膳老鸡白汤浓郁鲜甜，走地鸡肉质紧实弹嫩，通宵营业至凌晨4点
options.signature_dish_zh: 多伦多经典药膳滋补走地鸡煲与手切肥牛

review_notes_en.summary: Toronto Chinatown's iconic late-night chicken hot pot staple, perfect for post-study sessions and freezing winter nights.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍲 Signature Herbal Free-Range Chicken Pot / Pepper Pork Tripe Chicken Broth
🥩 Fresh Hand-Cut Beef, Ring Rolls & Handmade Shrimp Paste
review_notes_en.tips: Begin by ladling two comforting bowls of the rich aromatic broth before dipping fresh meats. Open until 2-4 AM for legendary midnight cravings.
review_notes_en.vibe: Steam-filled, bustling Cantonese late-night hot pot joint that instantly warms you up

options.name: Green Tea Restaurant
options.signature_dish: Bread Temptation & Sweet and Sour Pork Ribs
options.description: Famous Hangzhou Jiangnan chain featuring iconic Bread Temptation ice cream toast, caramelized sweet-and-sour ribs, and refined homestyle flavors.
options.address: 3235 Hwy 7 Unit 18, Markham, ON L3R 3P3
options.bullet_flavor: Delicate Jiangnan sweet-savory balance with buttery toasted bread and melting vanilla ice cream
options.bullet_highlight: Renowned Hangzhou casual dining chain famous for its signature Bread Temptation dessert and pleasant booth seating

review_notes.summary: 国内爆火的江浙菜绿茶餐厅万锦店！招牌面包诱惑无人能拒，甜口浓郁、菜品精致，极适合朋友聚餐。
review_notes.must_try:
🍞 招牌面包诱惑 (外脆内软黄油烤吐司堆香草冰淇淋)
🍖 绿茶糖醋小排 & 风味茄子 & 蒜蓉粉丝虾
review_notes.tips: 原DT店关闭后现迁至万锦Hwy 7；面包诱惑务必趁热吃，冰火交融的奶香极其惊艳；菜式偏江浙温润甜口。
review_notes.vibe: 雅致江南水乡中式卡座风格，安静舒适适宜聚餐交谈

highlights: Celebrated Hangzhou Jiangnan chain boasting cozy booth seating and approachable crowd-pleasing classics
Irresistible Bread Temptation hot buttered toast with melting ice cream alongside glossy sweet ribs
options.description_zh: 著名江浙菜连锁名店，以甜润适口的本帮糖醋小排、风味茄子与标志性甜品面包诱惑征服江南胃。
highlights_zh: 国内知名江浙菜品牌，卡座环境清幽雅致，适合朋友聚餐畅聊
无人能拒绝的招牌面包诱惑冰火交融，糖醋小排与茄子甜鲜浓郁
options.signature_dish_zh: 招牌面包诱惑佐冰淇淋与本帮糖醋小排

review_notes_en.summary: The popular Hangzhou Jiangnan brand's Markham outpost, celebrated for sweet-savory classics and the legendary Bread Temptation dessert.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍞 Signature Bread Temptation (Golden toasted honey brioche topped with melting vanilla ice cream)
🍖 Sweet and Sour Pork Ribs & Flavorful Braised Eggplant & Garlic Vermicelli Shrimp
review_notes_en.tips: Formerly in downtown, now settled in Markham along Hwy 7. Eat the Bread Temptation immediately while the warm buttery toast contrasts with the ice cream.
review_notes_en.vibe: Graceful, contemporary Jiangnan garden-inspired interior with quiet, comfortable booth seating

options.name: Trattoria Nervosa
options.signature_dish: Mafalde ai Funghi & Grilled Octopus
options.description: Charming yellow-cottage Yorkville Italian institution famous for decadent truffle mushroom mafalde pasta, grilled octopus, and romantic date-night charm.
options.address: 75 Yorkville Ave, Toronto, ON M5R 1B8
options.hours_note: Sun-Thu 11:30 AM - 10:00 PM, Fri-Sat 11:30 AM - 11:00 PM
options.bullet_flavor: Earthy white truffle cream sauce clinging to wavy mafalde pasta and tender charred octopus
options.bullet_highlight: Iconic two-storey yellow house in Yorkville boasting chic multi-level patios for romantic evenings

review_notes.summary: Yorkville奢侈品街旁的老牌地标级意餐！标志性黄色小洋楼与露台，约会、闺蜜小酌出片首选。
review_notes.must_try:
🍝 招牌黑松露菌菇波浪意面 (Mafalde ai Funghi)
🐙 香烤嫩章鱼 (Polpo) & 意式提拉米苏
review_notes.tips: 逛完Yorkville名店街后步行即达；Mafalde波浪意面挂满浓郁松露白酱，口感惊艳；夏秋露台与室内黄色小楼氛围感极佳。
review_notes.vibe: 浪漫时髦的约会胜地，黄昏时分华灯初上，微醺氛围感拉满

highlights: Iconic Yorkville yellow-house Italian landmark featuring romantic multi-tier patio seating
Rich truffle-cream mushroom mafalde pasta and tender grilled octopus for memorable date nights
options.name_zh: Trattoria Nervosa 意式约会餐厅
options.description_zh: Yorkville老牌地标级意式浪漫餐厅，坐落于标志性黄色小洋楼中，以浓郁黑松露菌菇意面与微醺约会氛围闻名。
highlights_zh: Yorkville奢侈品街老牌地标意餐，黄色小洋房与露台拍照超好看
招牌黑松露菌菇波浪面浓郁挂汁，香烤章鱼火候完美，约会微醺首选
options.signature_dish_zh: 招牌黑松露牛肝菌波浪意面与香烤章鱼

review_notes_en.summary: An enduring Yorkville Italian landmark housed in a signature yellow cottage, legendary for romantic patio vibes and rich handmade pasta.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍝 Mafalde ai Funghi (Wavy pasta ribbon in decadent portobello, cremini, and white truffle cream)
🐙 Polpo (Char-grilled tender octopus) & Classic Tiramisu
review_notes_en.tips: Conveniently located right off the Bloor-Yorkville luxury shopping strip. The signature truffle mafalde is an absolute must-order for rich pasta lovers.
review_notes_en.vibe: Chic, intimate Yorkville institution with ambient lamp-lit evenings and fashionable buzz

options.name: Marugame Udon
options.signature_dish: Nikutama Udon with Sweet Beef & Onsen Egg
options.description: Famous open-kitchen Japanese cafeteria serving chewy freshly-kneaded Sanuki udon bowls and crispy hot tempura at affordable prices.
options.address: 494 Yonge St, Toronto, ON M4Y 1X9
options.hours_note: Sun-Thu 11:00 AM - 10:00 PM, Fri-Sat 11:00 AM - 11:00 PM
options.bullet_flavor: Savory sweet-simmered beef, silky onsen tamago, and golden crispy shrimp or chicken tempura
options.bullet_highlight: Renowned Sanuki udon open kitchen with fast self-serve tempura bar and accessible prices

review_notes.summary: 全球知名赞岐乌冬专门店丸龟制面（Marugame Udon）多伦多DT首店！明档现做手打乌冬，出餐飞快且性价比极高。
review_notes.must_try:
🍜 招牌牛肉温玉乌冬 (Nikutama Udon) / 浓郁咖喱乌冬 / 经典清汤乌冬 (Kake Udon)
🍤 现炸大虾天妇罗 & 炸鸡块 (Karaage) & 温泉蛋
review_notes.tips: 采用经典日式自选动线：先选面条碗型，再沿托盘自选刚出锅的酥脆天妇罗和小食，最后结账；设有免费天妇罗花（面衣碎渣）、葱花和生姜自取台。
review_notes.vibe: 明亮宽敞的热闹日式快餐食堂，出餐高效，一人食或快节奏便餐首选

highlights: Theatrical open kitchen crafting chewy made-from-scratch Sanuki udon with rich dashi broth
Fast self-serve cafeteria line with piping-hot golden tempura, sweet nikutama beef, and accessible pricing
options.description_zh: 享誉全球的赞岐乌冬面专门店DT首店！开放式厨房现揉现煮Q弹劲道乌冬，自选金黄现炸天妇罗，平价快捷一人食神店。
highlights_zh: 全球连锁赞岐乌冬名店DT首店，开放式明档现揉现煮，乌冬面条Q弹爽滑劲道
自助式点餐动线出餐极快，招牌牛肉温玉汤底浓郁，搭配酥脆现炸天妇罗性价比绝佳
options.signature_dish_zh: 招牌牛肉温玉乌冬面佐现炸天妇罗

review_notes_en.summary: The celebrated global Sanuki udon specialist's downtown Toronto debut on Yonge, delivering handmade chewy noodles and quick self-serve tempura.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍜 Signature Nikutama Udon (Sweet-simmered beef & soft-poached onsen egg) / Rich Curry Udon / Classic Kake Udon
🍤 Freshly Fried Shrimp Tempura, Crispy Chicken Karaage & Zucchini Tempura
review_notes_en.tips: Follow the theater-style cafeteria line: choose your freshly made udon bowl at the open kitchen counter, grab crispy tempura from the heated racks, then pay. Stop by the condiment bar for complimentary green onions, grated ginger, and crispy tempura flakes.
review_notes_en.vibe: Bright, energetic Japanese open-kitchen canteen ideal for speedy solo dining and budget-friendly comfort eats

options.name: Kōst
options.signature_dish: Signature Sunset Cocktails & Tuna Tataki
options.description: Chic 44th-floor Bisha Hotel rooftop bar offering Baja-inspired cocktails, light coastal bites, and jaw-dropping CN Tower skyline panoramas.
options.address: 80 Blue Jays Way, 44th Floor, Toronto, ON M5V 2G3
options.hours_note: Mon-Sun 8:00 AM - 11:00 PM (Bar & Dinner from 5:00 PM)
options.bullet_flavor: Vibrant coastal citrus, agave spirits, refreshing tropical notes, and fresh seafood bites
options.bullet_highlight: Bisha Hotel 44th-floor rooftop oasis with infinity pool and unmatched CN Tower skyline vistas

review_notes.summary: 坐落于多伦多市中心Bisha精品酒店44层的顶级高空屋顶酒吧！紧邻CN塔与天际线无边泳池，俯瞰全城景致极其震撼。
review_notes.must_try:
🍸 招牌日落特调鸡尾酒 (Signature Sun-Drenched Cocktails) & 龙舌兰/梅斯卡尔特调
🍣 香煎金枪鱼塔塔 (Tuna Tataki) & 龙虾卷 / 松露薯条
review_notes.tips: 极力推荐在黄昏日落前半小时入座，能同时欣赏金色余晖洒在安大略湖和入夜后CN塔璀璨亮灯；露台高空风大，秋冬建议携带外套；强烈建议提前在官网OpenTable预订室内或露台靠窗座位。
review_notes.vibe: 时髦奢华的高空度假风屋顶酒吧，全景观落地窗与无边泳池景致，约会拍照绝佳

highlights: Glamorous 44th-floor rooftop lounge boasting panoramic CN Tower views, infinity pool, and vibrant coastal vibes
Baja-inspired craft cocktails paired with light seafood bites, perfect for golden hour and late-night drinks
options.name_zh: Kōst 屋顶高空全景酒吧餐厅
options.description_zh: 坐落于Bisha酒店44层的标志性高空屋顶酒吧，坐拥无边泳池与近在咫尺的CN塔天际线绝美日落全景，氛围感拉满。
highlights_zh: Bisha酒店44层标志性高空天台，正对CN塔与城市天际线，黄昏日落与无边泳池景观绝美
主打加州海岸风情特调鸡尾酒与精致轻食小点，约会、闺蜜聚会与夜景观光微醺首选
options.signature_dish_zh: 特调高空日落鸡尾酒与香煎金枪鱼塔塔

review_notes_en.summary: Perched on the 44th floor of Bisha Hotel, Kōst is one of downtown Toronto's premier rooftop lounges, offering sweeping skyline and CN Tower views.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍸 Signature Coastal Agave Cocktails & Refreshing Sunset Spritzes
🍣 Ahi Tuna Tataki, Fresh Guacamole with Taro Chips & Crispy Calamari
review_notes_en.tips: Book a reservation for golden hour (30-45 minutes before sunset) to catch breathtaking colors reflecting off Lake Ontario and the CN Tower illuminations. Tables fill up quickly on weekends; reservations via OpenTable are strongly recommended.
review_notes_en.vibe: Upscale, breezy Californian coastal retreat in the sky with floor-to-ceiling glass and lively music

options.name: Xi Noodle House
options.signature_dish: Shanxi Oil-Splashed Noodles (You Po Mian)
options.description: Trendy Shanxi knife-cut noodle spot on Yonge St with sizzling oil-splashed noodles, wandza noodles and lunch queues.
options.address: 510 Yonge St, Toronto, ON M4Y 1X9
options.bullet_flavor: Fiery oil-splashed noodles with rich, savory wandza broth
options.bullet_highlight: UT student noodle canteen with hand-cut Shanxi noodles

review_notes.summary: DTYonge街新开的山西刀削面馆，明厨现制，油泼面与豌杂面都是热门，午饭与下课排号等位要耐心。
review_notes.must_try:
🍅 特色油泼面（牛肉/猪肉，柿子鸡蛋卤中和微辣）
🌶️ 特色豌杂面（麻酱浓汤底，半个卤蛋）
review_notes.tips: 人多时油泼面出餐较慢，急的话可电话takeout；现金付款有折扣，记得带现金。
review_notes.vibe: 小店面明厨亮灶， UT学生食堂级热闹，适合一人食快吃

highlights: New Shanxi knife-cut noodle spot on Yonge with banging oil-splashed noodles
Hand-cut noodles with rich wandza broth, cash discount and steady lunch queues
options.description_zh: DT Yonge街新开的山西刀削面馆，主打手工刀削面，特色油泼面与豌杂面口碑火，学生午饭常常要排号。
highlights_zh: DT Yonge街山西刀削面新店，油泼面与豌杂面深受好评
明厨亮灶现制手削面，现金优惠，UT学生食堂首选
options.signature_dish_zh: 特色油泼面与豌杂面

review_notes_en.summary: Newly opened Shanxi knife-cut noodle house at 510 Yonge serving hot oil-splashed and wandza noodles, very popular with UT students.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍅 Signature You Po Noodles (beef or pork, mildly spicy with tomato-egg sauce)
🌶️ Signature Wandza Noodles (rich sesame paste broth, half braised egg)
review_notes_en.tips: Peak lunch lines can mean long waits; call ahead for takeout. Cash payments get a discount.
review_notes_en.vibe: Compact open-kitchen noodle canteen, fast-casual and student-heavy

options.name: Los Gyros
options.signature_dish: Molcajete Los Gyros (sizzling volcanic stone platter)
options.description: Generous North York Mexican taqueria known for meat-loaded taco platters, sizzling molcajete platters and fast casual energy.
options.address: 816 Sheppard Ave W, Toronto, ON M3H 2T1
options.bullet_flavor: Smoky grilled meats, al pastor pork and fiery molcajete skillet
options.bullet_highlight: Loaded taco platters and a sizzling volcanic-stone molcajete built for sharing

review_notes.summary: 北约克市头地道墨西哥馆子，偏街头风而非精致摆盘，肉给得实在，适合多人多点几种taco和molcajete一起分享。
review_notes.must_try:
🌮 Taco Platter（Al Pastor / Carne Asada / Suadero 混搭）
🔥 Molcajete Los Gyros（火山石锅杂烩，pork chop/chorizo/牛排/虾一锅）
review_notes.tips: 4点左右去不用排太久；牛舌taco炖得软嫩，喜欢牛舌的可以点；一定要挤 lime。
review_notes.vibe: 热闹的墨西哥街头风小馆，conceptual for group sharing

highlights: Authentic North York Mexican spot with generous, street-style portions
Sizzling molcajete stone platters and loaded taco platters built for sharing
options.description_zh: 北约克高人气墨西哥馆，主打街头风Taco拼盘与滋滋作响的Molcajete火山石锅，够朋友聚餐点一桌。
highlights_zh: 北约克地道墨西哥菜馆，肉给得很大方，街头风
招牌火山石锅Molcajete与Taco拼盘，适合多人分享
options.signature_dish_zh: Molcajete 火山石锅杂烩

review_notes_en.summary: Popular North York taqueria with street-style vibes, meat-heavy taco platters and a showpiece sizzling molcajete.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🌮 Taco Platter (Al Pastor / Carne Asada / Suadero mix)
🔥 Molcajete Los Gyros (volcanic stone platter with pork chop, chorizo, steak and shrimp)
review_notes_en.tips: Go around 4pm to dodge the line; the lengua (beef tongue) taco is tender and worth trying; finish with lime.
review_notes_en.vibe: Lively, street-style Mexican taqueria perfect for group meals

options.name: Good Luck HK Cafe
options.signature_dish: Char-Grilled Mixed Meat Rice (Oily Rush over Rice)
options.description: North York Hong Kong-style cha chaan teng with retro-red plates, Michelin-designed dinner set and smoky grilled meat rice bowls.
options.address: 5533 Yonge St, North York, ON M2N 7L3
options.bullet_flavor: Smoky char-grilled meats with hearty HK-style rice and claypot dishes
options.bullet_highlight: Retro cha chaan teng vibe with a Michelin-inspired dinner set menu

review_notes.summary: 北约克的茶餐厅，号称晚餐菜单请米其林厨师设计，红色复古餐具氛围感满分，烧腊饭与海鲜炖饭都惊喜。
review_notes.must_try:
🍚 黯然销魂烧腊饭（各式烧腊肉铺满，锅巴米饭绝了）
🦐 潮式海鲜炖饭（海鲜香奶香的潮式 risotto）
review_notes.tips: 晚餐有茶餐厅常规菜单加特别套餐，选择多；烟熏烤串、生腌泰式扇贝也不错；人均约35刀。
review_notes.vibe: 复古红色餐盘茶餐厅，晚餐氛围感十足，适合漂亮饭

highlights: Hong Kong-style cha chaan teng with retro red plates and Michelin-designed dinner set
Char-grilled meat rice bowls and smoky skewers are the signature comfort hits
options.description_zh: 北约克人气港式茶餐厅，主打复古红盘氛围与请米其林厨师设计的晚餐特别菜单，黯然销魂烧腊饭与潮式海鲜炖饭是招牌。
highlights_zh: 港式茶餐厅，红盘复古美学，晚餐菜单据说请米其林厨师设计
招牌黯然销魂烧腊饭与烟熏烤串，是北约克的漂亮饭晚餐
options.signature_dish_zh: 黯然销魂烧腊饭

review_notes_en.summary: Trendy North York cha chaan teng with retro-red dishware, a Michelin-designed dinner set and crowd-pleasing char-grilled rice bowls.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍚 Signature Char-Grilled Mixed-Meat Rice (layers of roast meats with crispy rice crust)
🦐 Chaoshan-Style Seafood Risotto (savory seafood-scented rice casserole)
review_notes_en.tips: Dinner offers both a standard cha chaan teng menu and a special set menu; smoky skewers and Thai-style marinated scallops are also great. Expect roughly $35 per person with tax and tip.
review_notes_en.vibe: Retro HK diner atmosphere with red plates, ideal for a cozy date-night dinner

options.name: Pears Restaurant
options.signature_dish: Taro & Mochi Pie with coconut cream
options.description: Stylish Markham Asian brasserie by chef Keith Pears serving inventive fusion plates, moody cocktails and buzzy date-night energy.
options.address: 8130 Birchmount Rd, Markham, ON L6G 0E4
options.bullet_flavor: Inventive Asian-fusion plates, mala cream udon and taro mochi dessert
options.bullet_highlight: Chef Keith Pears' buzzy brasserie with moody cocktails and plant-filled space

review_notes.summary: 万锦人气融合菜馆，简约高级感+绿植，适合约会；韩式炸鸡slider、花生酱鸡沙爹、麻辣奶油乌冬与芋泥麻薯派都值得点。
review_notes.must_try:
🍔 Sliders（甜辣韩式炸鸡迷你堡）
🍝 Mala Cream Carbonara（乌冬+麻辣奶油+温泉蛋）
🥧 Taro & Mochi Pie（千层酥皮芋泥麻薯派）
review_notes.tips: 人很多但不吵不挤，动静好；热门cocktail如Zavatar（烟熏泡泡）、Plum Seika点燃火焰出品很有仪式感。
review_notes.vibe: 简约高级感的绿植餐厅，夜晚灯光氛围适合date night

highlights: Buzzy Markham brasserie by Chef Keith Pears with inventive Asian-fusion plates
Mala cream udon, taro mochi pie and theatrical cocktails set the mood
options.description_zh: 万锦人气融合餐厅，主厨Keith Pears 打造，绿植空间氛围感好，招牌菜包括麻辣奶油乌冬、芋泥麻薯派与主题鸡尾酒。
highlights_zh: 万锦约会首选融合菜馆，简约高级感绿植空间
麻辣奶油乌冬、韩式炸鸡slider与芋泥麻薯派人气出圈
options.signature_dish_zh: 麻辣奶油乌冬与芋泥麻薯派

review_notes_en.summary: Locally beloved Markham fusion restaurant with sleek plant-filled interiors, inventive small plates and showy cocktails.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍔 Sliders (sweet-spicy Korean fried chicken sliders)
🍝 Mala Cream Carbonara (udon, spicy cream sauce, onsen egg)
🥧 Taro & Mochi Pie (taro-mochi filled mille-feuille pastry)
review_notes_en.tips: Busy but never cramped; order one of the signature cocktails like Zavatar (smoky bubble) or Plum Seika (flamed) for full theatre.
review_notes_en.vibe: Slick, green-accented date-night dining room with buzzy but relaxed energy
